lines: const blobs=[]; for(let i=0;i<MAX_BLOBS;i++) blobs.push(new Blob(i));
// stagger initial heights so motion is visible on first load
+blobs.forEach((b,i)=>{ if(!b.pool){ const f=((i*0.618)%1); b.pos.y=GLASS_Y0+0.30+f*1.70 + Math.sin(i*2.3)*0.05; b.pos.x=Math.cos(i*2.1)*0.14; b.pos.z=Math.sin(i*2.1)*0.14; b.temp=0.30+0.55*f; }});
